# Mosaic Remover For Windows x64

I distribute this portable build with the DLLs it needs. Extract the entire repository download and run `mosaic-remover.exe` from this directory. Keep the DLLs next to the executable. I use H.264 for MP4 export and FFV1 for lossless Matroska export.

I license the application under GPL-2.0-or-later. See [GPL-2.0](licenses/GPL-2.0.txt) and the other notices in the [Licenses](licenses/) directory. The corresponding application source and build files are in this repository. The [Dependency Sources](../../vendor/sources/) directory contains the exact source archives for the bundled SDL2, FFmpeg, x264, and Winpthreads binaries. The [Build Instructions](../../README.md) explain how to rebuild them.
